bookingPolicy: Ticket Booking must be done for the current date only.
Your ticket must be scanned for entry within 240 minutes of booking.
After 240 minutes, entry will not be permitted, and a new ticket will be required.
Please plan your travel accordingly to avoid inconvenience.

Attention Passenger! Premium Class facility is available only on Namo Bharat (RRTS) trains. While travelling to any of the Meerut Metro (MRTS) stations by Namo Bharat (RRTS) train, please deboard at the interchange station and board the Meerut Metro (MRTS) train.
Passengers are advised to check connecting last train timings towards destination stations before booking for Meerut Metro or Namo Bharat trains.
